'''Veedaaz Awmetth''' was a [[humanoid]] [[Politics|politician]] who served as a [[senator]] of the [[Galactic Senate]] during the [[Republic Era]]. They were an ally to [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], and were one of the many thousands of mourners to attend her [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] on [[Naboo]]<ref name="SWVE" /> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Veedaaz Awmetth was a character portrayed by [[Nicholas Ferguson]] for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="SWI74">{{InsiderCite|74|Prequel Update}}</ref> however they never made it into the final release of the film.

Their first official canon appearance was in the [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]] [[Star Wars: Card Trader]] app,<ref name="Topps">{{SWCT|set=Topps Choice 2|cardname=Veedaaz Awmetth}}</ref> before making another appearance in ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="SWVE" />

[[Dave Elsey]], the creature shop creative supervisor for Episode III, based Awmetth's appearance on an initial design of [[Darth Sidious]].<ref name="SWI74" />

In the 2015 non-canon video game ''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]'', Veedaaz Awmetth was identifed as a Sarrish diplomat.<ref name="Disney Infinity 3.0">''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''</ref> Despite the game being non-[[canon]], story group member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed on [[wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that the names provided by the game for previously unidentified characters were considered canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/749616406245699584|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-07-03|quote=@LelalMekha Yeah, same with Infinity.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-LegoName-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: "@pablohidalgo <nowiki>youtube.com/watch?v=JwxAeHPLpPg</nowiki> The Lego game identifies a few BG characters from TFA, but are those names canonical?"}}</ref> However, it is unknown if the designation referred to Awmetth's species.
